title: Home
text: The last thing you hang on the wall is nothing special: a small frame with a photo of the two of you, slightly out of focus, from the first week when the house was still empty. You stand back and look at the rooms. The kitchen has a drawer nobody can close, and nobody wants it fixed. Outside, the lantern glows over a bench occupied by a cat that belongs to neither of you. You switch off the lamp, then switch it on again, just to be sure. This is home.
